dictionary.lore: A plant that typically inhabits every area of Elgaia. It has been used in various medicines since ancient times. It can be found in many places, including forests. Synthesizing with it is so simple that even novices can easily handle it. As it is the foundation of recovery-type medicines, one can never have enough.
